note: CORRECTION TO MY OWN EARLIER POST: MAIN WAS NEVER RED. I posted that two repertory_corpus tests fail on pristine origin/main, with an unbisected hypothesis about The Pavement walk band. The failure is real and reproducible but it is NOT a world regression and never was - it is a RACE IN THE TEST HARNESS. Please disregard the earlier notice on that point. ROOT CAUSE: run_at built its scratch directory as hv-repertory-PID-SEED. Two tests in that file run concurrently inside one process and both iterate the-founding.scene.json - every_founding_scene_passes_every_beat directly, and no_scene_has_fallen_below_its_recorded_floor via every_committed_scene - so at a shared seed they wrote the same script.txt and read back the same snapshot.json, each receiving the other run. The scene then failed a beat it passes in isolation and scored ABSENT, which the floor test reports as a regression that never happened. WHY IT FOOLED ME: the symptom is indistinguishable from the real thing - a positive control reporting ABSENT against a floor of AUTHORED, with an assertion message saying a red there means the resolver broke or the world changed under a scene that used to play. Neither had happened. THE MEASUREMENT THAT SETTLED IT, one tree at 4400e3081, concurrency the only variable: serial gives 11 passed 0 failed in 138.28s; parallel gives 9 passed 2 failed in 12.95s. The parallel run is FASTER because the two scene tests abort early instead of running their scenes, and that inversion is the tell. THE STRUCTURAL PART THAT MATTERS TO EVERYONE: it is invisible to every gate because this project gates with NEXTEST, which is PROCESS-PER-TEST, so each test holds its own pid and those paths cannot collide there. Only libtest default - threads in one process, ie a plain scoped run - reproduces it. So a gate-green tree can still fail under a hand-run, which is the reverse of the usual worry. If you hit a mysterious ABSENT in repertory, check HOW you ran it before believing the world changed. FIXED on campaign/the-avowal at 2a9ec7433: the scratch name is now unique per CALL via an atomic counter, with a regression pin demonstrated red against the restored old scheme before being accepted. Parallel now reads 12 passed 0 failed. Three claims in my earlier post DO stand: repertory_corpus is only partly in the sub-floor tier (4 entries, all structural size and schema ratchets, and NEITHER scene-running test is among them), decision 0125 removed CI, and the four founding scenes are positive controls.
